scope: Four exact single first-image A2V sources. pairs is retained validator transport vocabulary; each shot has one source panel, no end-condition image. All four full native PNGs and all ten unscaled native detail aids were visually inspected. No generated motion, original-song articulation, phoneme synchronization or final edit reviewed.

pairs.observed: Front medium Yaro: brown tousled hair, blue-grey eyes and light stubble match the established lead; leather jacket, burgundy shirt and round silver disc without cross. One microphone in anatomical RIGHT hand (viewer-left), ring/cuff and connected forearm. Free LEFT hand has a plausible open-palm silhouette and connected wrist near the waist. Modestly parted mouth is distinct from the mic. Blue curtain, truss, beams and left amp replace the exposed empty drumkit; no visible empty drum seat/kit or extra performer.
pairs.motion_limits_or_required_fix: Test restrained upper-body/breath and audio-conditioned mouth movement; keep the free left palm near the waist. Preserve right-hand mic ownership, grip, cable, ring/cuff and coherent five-finger silhouettes. No microphone-mouth fusion, finger duplication, detached arm, fixed-mouth substitute or jaw snapping. Preserve round disc and lead identity. Repaired background must remain stable without empty kit reappearing. Actual original-song articulation and all motion remain unreviewed.

pairs.observed: Close three-quarter Yaro preserves hair, blue-grey eyes, light stubble, leather/burgundy outfit and round silver disc. Anatomical RIGHT hand wraps the one microphone, with connected wrist, ring and cuff; partly occluded fingers form a plausible grip. Lips and teeth are modestly parted with a visible gap to the microphone. Free left hand and other band members are outside frame. Repaired blue curtain/truss/beam background contains no empty drum gear or ghost performer.
pairs.motion_limits_or_required_fix: Use bounded close-up head/eye/breath movement with true audio-conditioned articulation. Preserve neck/jaw connection, single microphone, right-hand grip and stable lip/mic separation. Do not reveal a new arm or invent a hand swap. No teeth doubling, rubber mouth, mic fusion, face/eye drift or pendant-to-cross change. Keep curtain/truss geometry stable. Actual original-song articulation and motion remain unreviewed.

pairs.observed: Medium three-quarter Yaro preserves the established lead face, hair, light stubble and leather/burgundy outfit; the pendant is a neutral round disc. Anatomical RIGHT hand holds the one microphone with connected arm. Anatomical LEFT arm extends viewer-right to a readable open palm, thumb and four-finger silhouette; wrist/forearm are connected. Mouth is slightly open and distinct from mic. Blue curtain/truss/beam and left amp background contains no exposed empty drumkit or ghost performer.
pairs.motion_limits_or_required_fix: Keep the left open hand connected and in its own space during a small controlled offering gesture; no reach toward another body or mic handoff. Preserve the right-hand mic, cable, ring/cuff, round disc, five-finger anatomy and lead face. Audio-conditioned mouth movement must remain separate from the mic, with no snapping jaw or duplicated teeth. Keep repaired background stable with no gear/performer ghosts. Actual motion and song synchronization remain unreviewed.

pairs.observed: Frontal close Yaro preserves the blue-grey eyes, light stubble, tousled brown hair and leather/burgundy stage clothes. One mic remains in anatomical RIGHT hand, with plausible wrapped grip, ring, cuff and connected wrist. Lips are slightly parted above the mic; no duplicated teeth or visibly fused jaw in this still. The partly cropped necklace ends in a round disc, not a cross. Blue curtain/truss/beams contain no empty drum gear or ghost performer; free hand is outside frame.
pairs.motion_limits_or_required_fix: Use restrained close-up head/eye/breath movement and true audio-conditioned articulation. Preserve right-hand microphone grip, ring/cuff, connected wrist/neck, eye identity, light stubble and round-disc necklace. Do not invent free hands in frame, duplicate teeth/fingers or fuse mic to lips. Keep curtain/truss/beam geometry stable. Actual motion, expressive cadence and original-song phoneme synchronization remain separate review gates.

required_review_criteria: Preserve established Yaro face, blue-grey eyes, brown hair, light stubble, black/burgundy stage outfit and round disc without cross
Inspect exact PNG plus native face/microphone-hand/free-hand aids; plausible fingers, connected arms, mic ownership and suitable mouth state
Check stage continuity: medium solo shots must not visibly establish an empty drum kit if the band is playing there. Tight close views may hide drummer outside frame; judge actual image evidence.
Verify source first-image suitability only, no promised phoneme/song synchronization or actual action approval

For an accepted source only, set pair verdict PASS_STATIC_SOURCE_FOR_BOUNDED_MOTION_TEST and corresponding native_pixels_viewed true after actual inspection. Leave holds rejected/pending; never set flag merely because template contains hashes.
repair_intent: Remove visible unoccupied drum gear; preserve lead identity and playing/singing pose. Template records no approval.
repair_observation: V2 removes the visible unoccupied drum gear from the solo-source backgrounds and replaces it with blue curtain/truss/beams. The inspected four current sources preserve the lead face, mic ownership, costume, round pendant and poses; no band ghost or replacement empty kit is visible. Earlier V1 hold remains untouched as historical evidence.
authorization_limit: This record accepts the exact static sources for bounded testing. It does not authorize paid calls, GPU jobs, provider spending, publishing, final adoption or claims of original-song lip synchronization. Pilot output, remaining quota and actual motion must pass their separate gates.
